mic.evidence: The red sound sensor module with a black microphone cylinder and blue potentiometer is located at the top of the breadboard.

mic_out.evidence: The purple wire connected to the AO pin of the sound sensor leads to the A0 analog input on the Arduino.

rgb.evidence: The small black RGB LED module with a clear LED is located on the breadboard below the microphone.

found: Wire connected to the first pin of the RGB module
Wire connected to the second pin of the RGB module
Wire connected to the third pin of the RGB module
Wire connected to the fourth pin of the RGB module
rgb_wires.evidence: Four wires are connected to the four pins of the RGB module, leading into the breadboard.

gnd_other_end.evidence: The black wire from the Arduino GND pin connects to the negative rail (blue line) of the breadboard.
